buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Scope of supply: One set of Merkel V-packing Set V1000,Type 1000/VPS-0106 and Merkel P/t No. 24334188 for 2000 Ton pres s hydraulic system.The packing has an inner diameter of 720 mm,an outer diameter of 780 mm,a seal of width 205 mm and is o f split type(1+3+1).The material of construction is BI-NBR B6B210. II. Eligibility Criteria: Only bidders who qualify on following criteria are eligible to participate in the tender: a) This is a case of procurement of proprietary item.The offered material shall be of FREUDENBERG-Merkel make.The bidder shall submit a valid authorised dealership/authorisation certificate by the manufacturer along with the offer. b) The offered material shall fully conform to the specifications, dimensions, material grade, design and other requirements specified in the attached Material data sheet( Annexure-1) of the Buyer Specification document.The bidder shall submit a d uly signed No-deviation/Technical Compliance Certificate confirming full compliance of Annexure-1. OEM shall be severally and jointly responsible along with the bidder for performance of the contract. Note: a) SAIL reserves the right to verify any supporting document(s) submitted by a participating tenderer/bidder from its source(doc ument issuing authority) b) In the interest of expeditious completion of verification, a participating tenderer/bidder shall provide a list of each supporting document on its letterhead as per “Annexure-S”along with the contact details (postal address, email address, landline/mobile n umber)of the issuing authority of each supporting document of verification. c) Non-verification of any supporting document or information at the sole discretion of SAIL, does not absolve the tenderer/bidder of its absolute responsibility to provide only genius document(s)in support of eligibility conditions. d) In case a supporting document or information is found to be fake/forged/tampered/non-genuine at any stage during tendering process and even after placement of purchase order/work order, the tenderer/bidder is liable for punitive actions as p er extant guidelines of SAIL. III.Manufacturer's T/c & G/c should be submitted along with supply. IV. Documents required to be uploaded with tender: a) OEM authorisation certificate. b) Bid Securing Declaration (Annexure-1 of ATC) c) Non-Collusive Certificate.(Annexure-4 of ATC) d) Relationship declaration with SAIL(Refer ATC 1(d))

e) Land Border Sharing declaration as per format in ATC and as applicable(Annexure-2 of ATC) f) Declaration of local content under Make in India(Annexure-3 of ATC) g) Declaration in regards to No Adverse Performance in past with SAIL (Form B) h) Anti-bribery declaration(Annexure-5 of ATC) j) Annexure”S” V. Guaranty/warranty: The tenderer shall give a guarantee / warranty for satisfactory performance of the supplied materials as per Standard Warranty terms of the OEM. The supplier shall be responsible for any defect that may, under the condition provide d for by the contract and under proper use, arise due to faulty materials, design or workmanship and shall remedy such defect a t his own cost. If it becomes so necessary for the supplier to replace or to renew any defective part, such replacement or renewal shall be made by the supplier 100 % free of cost without any extra cost to the Buyer. The new goods should be supplie d on FOR destination basis free of cost. Fitment Guarantee Certificate: Bidders to submit a self-certificate confirming that offered parts is exact replacement of original part and fully interchangeable to the original part and will fit and function on the equipment for which these are intended for wit hout any modification. VI. Risk Purchase – If the supplier fails to deliver the stores either in full or in part, within the prescribed delivery period, the Purchaser shall be entitled at his option to take alternate procurement action, at the risk & cost of the supplier for the unsupplie d portion of the goods/items for which delivery has expired without cancelling the contract in respect of stores not yet due for d elivery, or to cancel the contract based on progress of work , including stores not due for delivery, and, if thought fit/ necessary, to purchase the stores at the risk and cost of the supplier. The price differential in case of higher cost to SAIL,if any, shall have t o be borne by the defaulting supplier. Moreover the defaulting supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed t o supply. VIII. Banning of Business Dealings: On arising any situation or occurrence of any event as mentioned in Clause 6 of the Guidelin es on Banning of Business Dealings available on SAIL Tender website(www.sailtenders.com) , the tenderer/bidder or supplier un der the tendering process or contract with SAIL,as the case may be, shall be liable for action under and in accordance with the a forementioned Guidelines.The “Guidelines on Banning of Business Dealings” shall form part of the Tender/Contract. . 2. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller.
